tasks.title: Prepare and sow
tasks.detail: Use a clean container with drainage or a prepared garden bed. Sow verified edible vegetable-amaranth seed; follow seed-packet spacing and depth.

tasks.title: Check for emergence
tasks.detail: Inspect soil moisture and seedlings. Do not assume a fixed germination date.

tasks.title: Thin and observe
tasks.detail: If seedlings are crowded, thin according to the seed variety and garden space. Record leaf growth.

tasks.title: Inspect for harvest readiness
tasks.detail: Check tender leaf size and plant health. Harvest only when suitable; do not rely on the calendar alone.

tasks.title: Consider first tender-leaf harvest
tasks.detail: Harvest clean tender leaves when ready; use safe water and clean tools. Record measured yield.

troubleshooting.checks: Check soil moisture and drainage, midday heat and root damage before changing watering.
Inspect leaf undersides for insects; identify pests before choosing any treatment.
Check waterlogging, plant nutrition and age; multiple causes are possible.

harvestEvidence.claim: 35–45 days after planting or sowing, depending on variety and harvesting method

tasks.title: Prepare planting space
tasks.detail: Select verified edible jute-mallow seed and a well-drained bed; use locally reviewed planting instructions.

tasks.title: Observe establishment
tasks.detail: Record emergence and check for standing water or drought stress.

tasks.title: Monitor leaf development
tasks.detail: Observe leaf growth and pests; first harvest timing requires local verification.

troubleshooting.checks: Check seed viability, soil crusting, moisture and planting depth.
Check sunlight, drainage and competition; consult local extension guidance.

tasks.title: Plan adequate space
tasks.detail: Use appropriate locally sourced planting material. Vines require substantial space and management.

tasks.title: Observe vine establishment
tasks.detail: Inspect vines, leaf health and available growing space; do not assume first harvest at a fixed date.

tasks.title: Review harvest readiness
tasks.detail: Consult locally reviewed guidance before harvesting tender leaves.

troubleshooting.checks: Inspect moisture, drainage, sunlight and planting material health.

tasks.title: Plant suitable seed
tasks.detail: Choose a locally appropriate okra variety, warm site and adequate root space; follow seed instructions.

tasks.title: Inspect seedlings
tasks.detail: Observe emergence, weeds and insect damage; thin if needed.

tasks.title: Watch for flowering
tasks.detail: Monitor plant development; timing varies with variety and conditions.

tasks.title: Check tender pods
tasks.detail: Harvest pods when young and suitable for cooking; repeat checking regularly.

troubleshooting.checks: Consider heat, water stress and pollination; avoid assuming a single cause.
Harvest more frequently at a younger pod stage.

tasks.title: Sow cowpea
tasks.detail: Use an appropriate local variety, well-drained soil and suitable spacing.

tasks.title: Check establishment
tasks.detail: Inspect emergence, insects and soil moisture.

tasks.title: Observe flowering and pods
tasks.detail: Document flowering and pod development; edible green pods and dry grains have different harvest stages.

troubleshooting.checks: Identify the pest and seek locally approved integrated pest-management guidance.

tasks.title: Plant healthy cuttings
tasks.detail: Use correctly identified, healthy edible waterleaf cuttings in a well-drained container or bed.

tasks.title: Check rooting
tasks.detail: Inspect cuttings for new growth and rot; maintain adequate but not excessive moisture.

tasks.title: Monitor tender shoots
tasks.detail: Check plant establishment and leaf quality; do not harvest until sufficiently rooted and healthy.

troubleshooting.checks: Check excessive moisture, poor drainage and unhealthy planting material.
